import gc
import json
import sys
import time
import types
import urllib.request
import torch
from torch import nn

torch.set_num_threads(max(1, torch.get_num_threads()))
old_ln = types.ModuleType("mamba_ssm.ops.triton.layernorm")
class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size, eps=1e-5, device=None, dtype=None):
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size, device=device, dtype=dtype))
        self.eps = eps
    def forward(self, x):
        return x * torch.rsqrt(x.float().pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps).to(x.dtype) * self.weight
old_ln.RMSNorm = RMSNorm
old_ln.layer_norm_fn = None
old_ln.rms_norm_fn = None
sys.modules["mamba_ssm.ops.triton.layernorm"] = old_ln
import mamba_ssm.modules.mamba_simple as mamba_simple
from mamba_ssm.ops.selective_scan_interface import selective_scan_ref
mamba_simple.selective_scan_fn = selective_scan_ref
mamba_simple.causal_conv1d_fn = None
mamba_simple.causal_conv1d_update = None

from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForMaskedLM
model_name = "kuleshov-group/caduceus-ph_seqlen-131k_d_model-256_n_layer-16"
config = AutoConfig.from_pretrained(model_name, trust_remote_code=True)
config.fused_add_norm = False
config.ssm_cfg["use_fast_path"] = False
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name, trust_remote_code=True)
model = AutoModelForMaskedLM.from_pretrained(model_name, config=config, trust_remote_code=True).eval()
url = "https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/sequence?genome=hg38;chrom=chr12;start=7792299;end=7793299"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as response:
    seq = json.load(response)["dna"].upper()
assert len(seq) == 1000
original = tokenizer(seq, add_special_tokens=False, return_tensors="pt")["input_ids"][0]
assert original.numel() == 1000
results = []
with torch.inference_mode():
    for n in (1, 4, 8):
        batch = original.repeat(n, 1)
        pos = torch.arange(n)
        batch[torch.arange(n), pos] = tokenizer.mask_token_id
        started = time.perf_counter()
        logits = model(input_ids=batch).logits
        masked = logits[torch.arange(n), pos]
        assert masked.shape == (n, 16) and torch.isfinite(masked).all()
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
        results.append({"batch": n, "seconds": elapsed, "seconds_per_variant": elapsed / n})
        del batch, logits, masked
        gc.collect()
with open("benchmark.txt", "w") as h:
    h.write(json.dumps({"torch_threads": torch.get_num_threads(), "timings": results}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
